title: Quality Analyst
description:
About us:


DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.


About the job:


The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.


Audit & Compliance:

  • Conduct scheduled and unscheduled internal audits in accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.G., FAA, EASA, ANAC).
  • Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.
  • Assist in preparing for and supporting external audits (regulatory and customer).

Inspection Oversight:

  • Review work orders, inspection records, and traceability documentation for accuracy and completeness.
  • Observe and assess maintenance activities for conformity to procedures and applicable standards.
  • Verify proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Non-Conformance Management:

  • Identify and document non-conformances (NCRs) during audits or inspections.
  • Assist in root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective action implementation.
  • Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager.

Documentation & Records:

  • Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function.

Training & Communication:

  • Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
  • Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
  • Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
  • Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.


Work Experience:

Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.

Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.


Educational:

High school diploma or GED required;
associate or bachelor'sdegree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.


Soft Skills:

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

Effective written and verbal communication.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.

Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.


Full Time in Galeão - RJ.

description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Department: Sales


Role Summary


The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.

The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.


Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.


Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers .
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.
Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
Collaboratewith data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
OptimizeETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Maintainand improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshootand resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.
What we are looking for:
A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Curiosity:You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
Collaboration:Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship:You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
Fluent English:You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.
What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#BuildingonbeliefID:

title: Client services, interpretation (language services | research | due diligence | remote)
description:
About Us

We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs

Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective

You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing

Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills

Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges

You will work eitherAPAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - Lat Am applicants will work AMER hours)
Weekends and overnights shifts are availablewith a commensurate increase in compensation.Compensation & Benefits
Salary commensurate with experience
Paid time off
Health insurance
Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Tax coordinator
description:
The Regional Tax Coordinator will support the global tax function with end‑to‑end ownership of multi‑jurisdiction tax compliance, controversy, and operational readiness. The role encompasses direct and indirect taxes, withholding tax and treaty management, transfer pricing oversight, and implementation of new global regimes such as Pillar Two.
The coordinator will drive strategic tax planning initiatives that optimize the effective tax rate and cash taxes while ensuring robust compliance, operational substance, and scalable controls and automation. This position partners closely with finance, controllership, treasury, legal, and business teams to support new transactions, products, and market entries and to proactively assess permanent establishment and nexus risks.
RESPONSABILITIES
i. Ensures timely and accurate tax compliance across all in‑scope jurisdictions, including corporate income taxes, indirect taxes such as VAT, GST, ICMS, and ISS, and withholding tax returns and information reporting.
ii. The role owns the global tax calendar and filing controls, establishing standard operating procedures and clear accountabilities to maintain a consistently high on time filing rate and audit readiness.
iii. Map tax opportunities and risks, proposing and implementing tax planning initiatives and corporate restructurings aimed at tax efficiency and reduction of the overall tax burden.
iv. Act in a consultative capacity with business areas, treasury, and controllership, providing support on tax-related matters and new transactions.
v. Monitor changes in local and international tax legislation and ensure the implementation of internal improvements to comply with new regulations.
vi. Lead internal and external tax audits and inspections with authorities in Brazil and other jurisdictions, managing controversy strategies and external advisors to achieve efficient, defensible outcomes.
vii. Analyze due diligence reports and provide support for strategic projects, such as the development of new products and M& A transactions.
viii. Develop and monitor robust internal controls to mitigate tax risks.
ix. Prepare reports and documentation to support senior management in tax-related matters.
QUALIFICATIONS
i. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, law or related area
ii. Minimum 8 years of experience, (Big 4 or public company experience preferred)
iii. Language: English, advanced / Spanish, desirable
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
i. Strong knowledge of global tax laws, cross-border regulations, and transfer pricing principles.
ii. Proficiency with tax preparation software and ERP.
iii. Experience with Financial institutions is desirable
SOFT SKILLS
i. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
ii. Effective planning and priority setting
iii. Must be well organized and detail-oriented
iv. Teamwork
v. Clear and effective written and verbal communication
vi. Interpersonal and presentation skills
vii. Analytical skills

title: Senior full stack developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties:
You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.
Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.
Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and. Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & Dev Ops: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.
Nice to have:
Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
Spanish proficiency.
Ia C (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .
Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.
Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.
Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Consolidar e analisar indicadores contratuais e regulatórios.
Construir, atualizar e acompanhar modelos de fluxo de caixa e demonstrativos de resultado.
Avaliar impactos de eventos contratuais como reequilíbrios, pleitos, investimentos antecipados ou postergações.
Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas Jurídica, Regulatório, Planejamento Interno e stakeholders externos.
Apoiar análises de teses jurídicas sob a ótica econômico-financeira.
Garantir a manutenção do equilíbrio econômico-financeiro dos contratos.
Requisitos
Formação superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência em planejamento financeiro, concessões, PPPs ou contratos de longo prazo.
Domínio de modelagem econômico-financeira, fluxo de caixa e DRE.
Vivência em ambientes regulados será um diferencial.
Benefícios:

Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);

Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Kit office.
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!
Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.
Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.
Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Job Description
About You
You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.
You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (Py Spark is a strong plus).
Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Postgre SQL, or similar.

title: International buyer
description:
General Description
The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.
Detailed Description
Procurement of Materials & Parts:
Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).
Inventory Management:
Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.
Supplier Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.
Data Entry & Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.
Cost Control:
Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.
Qualification Minimum Requirements
Work Experience:
At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage
Educational:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Fluent/advanced English
Technical Skills:
Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).
Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)
Soft Skills:
Strong negotiation and communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.
Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.

title: Estilista especialista
description:
O Especialista Estilista é o mentor criativo responsável por idealizar e projetar as coleções de Athleisure, garantindo que a marca esteja na vanguarda das tendências mundiais de moda e comportamento. Sua missão é conceber o direcionamento estético e o conceito das coleções, transformando inspirações globais em produtos que equilibram perfeitamente o desejo de moda lifestyle com a funcionalidade esportiva. Curadoria de Materiais e Estilo: Selecionar matérias-primas e acabamentos que reforcem o posicionamento de moda tecnológica e lifestyle da marca.
Guardião do Lifestyle da Marca: Zelar pela consistência estética e pela evolução da imagem da marca, garantindo que o produto final seja uma referência de estilo no mercado.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada como Estilista Criativo, com histórico comprovado no desenvolvimento de coleções de moda, preferencialmente no nicho Sportswear ou Athleisure. Domínio Estético e Repertório: Profundo conhecimento de história da moda, tendências contemporâneas e capacidade de traduzir conceitos abstratos em coleções comerciais. Visão de Mercado Global: Habilidade para adaptar tendências internacionais para o contexto do varejo nacional, mantendo o DNA da marca. Habilidades Criativas: Domínio de ferramentas de ilustração e desenho de moda, com olhar apurado para proporções, cores e composições.

title: Especialista de modelagem hidráulica pleno
description:

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Elaborar e validar documentação técnica de estudos internos e de terceiros.
Desenvolver análises, cenários críticos e estudos de ampliação em sistemas de água e esgoto.

Participar da análise de viabilidade econômica de soluções técnicas de infraestrutura.
Atuar em demandas de novos negócios da companhia, com foco técnico na modelagem.

Contribuir em grupos de trabalho e iniciativas de evolução técnica da área.

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Sanitária, Ambiental ou correlatas.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. title: Analista de reforma tributária sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.

Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;

Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners
Department: Sales
Role Summary
The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M& O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.
The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M& O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Product & Solution Representation
Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards. Business Development
Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
Expand M& O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction. Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight
Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions. Sales Strategy & Reporting
Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M& O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.
Skills and Competencies B2 B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales. Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams. Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance. Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes. Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.
Experience Requirements 2 to 5 years of experience in B2 B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors. Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers . Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects. title: Desenvolvedor (a) pl
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais deR$10 bilhõesem nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactandomais de 100 mil lojase1,2 milhão de membrosentre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.Sobre a área de EngenhariaNa Juntos, o time de engenharia atua na evolução dos produtos, tanto em novas features como melhorias e evoluções técnicas. Além das evoluções também realiza a manutenção do produto e ajuda a melhorar a observabilidade das aplicações a cada feature nova lançada. A pessoa atuará na Squad Decisão de Compra responsável por impulsionar dentro da Juntos Loja campanhas promocionais atrativas praticadas em outros formatos de venda.Seu papel:Atuar em um ambiente ágil, participando de cerimônias como daily meetings, planning, refinement e retrospectives;
Colaborar com o time de produto para definir requisitos e entregar funcionalidades alinhadas às necessidades do negócio;
Desenvolver, manter e otimizar aplicações, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e segurança;
Implementar e seguir as boas práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo testes automatizados, code reviews e integração contínua;
Implementar soluções de infraestrutura na Azure e utilizando K8 S (Kubernetes) para gerenciar e escalar aplicações em containers;
Implementar modelos arquiteturais que envolvem firewall, gateway, load balancing, OAuth, Middleware ou BFF, garantindo a segurança e eficiência das integrações;
Conduzir diagnósticos e resoluções de problemas em produção, sempre focando na melhoria contínua dos sistemas.
A pessoa atuará na Squad Decisão de Compra responsável por impulsionar dentro da Juntos Loja campanhas promocionais atrativas praticadas em outros formatos de venda.O que esperamos de você:Sólidos conhecimentos em linguagem. NET.
Conhecimentos em Teste unitário, SQL, Docker, K8 S, REST, SWAGGER, Azure, Git e Gitflow;
Experiência desejável com publicadores/consumidores e serviços de mensageria;
Diferencial: conhecimento na linguagem Python (DRF)Se isso tudo faz sentido pra você, o próximo passo é seu. Vem ser Construtor(a) com a gente no maior Ecossistema da Construção Civil! ️Nosso processo seletivo e o compromisso com a Diversidade:Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil! ️Benefícios de ser um Construtor(a) na #Juntos
Por aqui, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é tão importante quanto alcançar resultados. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar sua saúde, bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida — dentro e fora do trabalho.Remuneração variável : reconhecemos resultados de forma justa e transparente.

title: Network engineer commissioning specialist (bsc/rnc), oss and sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.
This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.Responsibilities:
(Must-have). Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.
Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
Work collaboratively with planning, O&M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.Technical Requirements:
Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G networks.
Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.Desired Profile:
Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
Proactive and collaborative attitude.Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

title: Senior software engineer
description:
Teachableis a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Companyportfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!What is the role?
We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.In this role you'll:
Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.What You’ll Bring:
3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.Nice to have:
Golang experienceThis is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Pessoa desenvolvedora de software (back-end) pleno - afirmativa pcd
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história
Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.
Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.Missão do cargo:
Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.Como será o seu dia a dia no time:
Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Node JS
Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguroRESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
Linguagens de programação (Go, Node JS, SQL);
Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, etc);
Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
API Rest;
Programação concorrente e escalável;
Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
Promover nossa cultura e valores;
Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:
Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;

title: Customer success manager
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based, fast paced growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hireCustomer Success Managersto join our growing Customer Success team in North America.As aCustomer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveragingtechnical expertisewith astrategic business mindsetto build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.Responsibilities:
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.Requirements:
2-4 yearsof proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a Saa S company ( must ).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness tomeet clients onsiteand lead business discussions.
Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must.
A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.Why Join TITAN?:
Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing Saa S startup
Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development
